## Prompt Pack
Phong cách chung: ánh sáng tự nhiên, bảng màu be và xanh rêu, không dựng studio.

### Ảnh 1 — Hero
```text
Photo of a man in his 30s in a beige knit sweater, reading a paper menu at a small café table by a window, mid-sentence with a friend out of frame. A ceramic cup of tea and a folded newspaper on the table. Soft morning daylight from the left, gentle shadows. Shot on a recent smartphone, eye level, slightly off-center, horizontal 16:9 frame. Unposed, not retouched, not cinematic.
```

### Ảnh 2 — Hướng dẫn pha cà phê
```text
Photo of a woman in her 20s holding a white ceramic mug with the word "MORNING" printed on it, in a bright home kitchen. Her fingers stiff and pressed flat against the mug. Soft studio-style light from above, even and flattering. Shot on a recent smartphone, eye level. Visible skin texture. Unposed, not retouched, not cinematic.
```

### Ảnh 3 — Ảnh chia sẻ
```text
Overhead photo of a pour-over dripper on a wooden counter, a hand grinder and a scoop of coffee grounds, daylight from the window, items slightly misaligned. Horizontal 1.91:1 frame. Unposed, not retouched.
```

**Lời người dùng:** Ảnh 2 ra tay cầm cốc bị dính ngón, chữ trên cốc méo, ánh sáng như studio dù cảnh là trong bếp nhà. Sửa giúp ảnh 2 thôi, ảnh 1 và 3 ổn rồi.
